question: What is the term used for a pricing method in which companies group several products together and sell them at a single price?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bundle pricing**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bundle pricing**

 
 
• Bundle pricing is a marketing strategy where multiple products or services are bundled together and sold at a discounted price compared to buying them individually.
 
• This strategy can be beneficial for both businesses and customers.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Advantages of Bundle Pricing:**

 
 
• **Increased Sales:** Bundling can encourage customers to buy more products than they originally intended, leading to higher sales volumes.
 
• **Improved Profit Margins:** By bundling less popular products with popular ones, businesses can clear inventory and increase overall profitability.
 
• **Enhanced Customer Satisfaction:** Customers perceive greater value when they feel they are getting a better deal, leading to increased customer satisfaction and loyalty.
 
• Simplified Decision-Making: Bundles can simplify the purchasing process for customers, especially when dealing with complex product offerings.
 
 
 
• **Types of Bundle Pricing:**
 
 
• **Pure Bundling:** Customers can only purchase the products as a bundle.
 
• **Mixed Bundling: **Customers can choose to purchase products individually or as a bundle.
 
• **Component Bundling:** Customers can purchase individual components or a complete bundle.
